message: TASK-86 pad-dock takeoff is impossible in v1 physics (VTOL_LIFT = GRAVITY → neutral buoyancy; no thrust channel in atmosphere/surface, so a pad-docked ship can never generate |vel.y| ≥ 1 and the pad machine re-docks it — the client root cause IS fixed and home-dock takeoff is green). Fix by giving VTOL a climb margin (Option A: VTOL_LIFT = 1.35×GRAVITY in shared flight.ts — real takeoff, ripples to flight feel + flight/pads test expectations) vs close the task on the client fix only (Option B: pad e2e proves the first input frame reaches the server, home-dock e2e proves full takeoff, pad re-dock documented as v1 behavior)?
